meta.title: RFQ bid: Quote only one of two products
gaps: The catalog has no dedicated step to identify the unnamed first product and quote only that product using the vendor portal's product-specific control; the generic fill relies on an unconfirmed first-product region.
The catalog cannot assert either of the two alternative refusal messages as an OR condition; the refusal attempt can record the actual message instead.

steps.note: Start a fresh multi-stage event create flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply RFQ-specific template and sheet configuration.
Choose an RFQ pricing template before adding products.
Create the two products required by the scenario.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor who will attempt the partial quote.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ's pricing bid sheet from the vendor event list.
Enter a price only in the first product's pricing field; the second product is intentionally left blank.
Submit the partial quote and record the product's actual refusal message, including which supported wording applies.
